options.name: Obscure
options.duration: until the end of its next turn

arcane-trickster.summary: A Rogue who adds Intelligence-based Wizard magic and an unseen Mage Hand to a burglar's toolkit.

Spellcasting.summary: Third-caster on the Wizard list with INT: Mage Hand plus 2 more Wizard cantrips (one more at Rogue 10) and 3 prepared level 1 Wizard spells, growing per the Arcane Trickster table up to level 4 slots. Swap a cantrip (not Mage Hand) or a spell each Rogue level; an Arcane Focus works.

Mage Hand Legerdemain.summary: Mage Hand can be cast as a Bonus Action and made Invisible; steer it as a Bonus Action and use it for Sleight of Hand checks.

Magical Ambush.summary: While you're Invisible, a creature you target with a spell has Disadvantage on its saves against that spell this turn.

Versatile Trickster.summary: When you Trip a creature with Cunning Strike, you may also Trip a second creature within 5 ft of your Mage Hand.

Spell Thief.summary: Reaction after a creature's spell targets or includes you: it makes an INT save vs your spell DC. On a fail the spell doesn't affect you, and if it's a level 1+ spell whose level you have slots for, you keep it prepared for 8 hours while the caster can't use it. 1/Long Rest.

assassin.summary: A Rogue built for ambushes, poison and disguise, striking hardest before foes can act.

Assassinate.summary: Advantage on Initiative. In combat's first round, Advantage on attacks against creatures that haven't acted yet, and a Sneak Attack hit that round adds damage equal to your Rogue level, of the weapon's type.

Assassin's Tools.summary: Proficiency with, and one each of, the Disguise Kit and Poisoner's Kit.

Infiltration Expertise.summary: After 1 hour of study you can flawlessly copy a person's voice, handwriting or both, and Steady Aim no longer drops your Speed to 0.

Envenom Weapons.summary: Your Cunning Strike Poison also deals 2d6 Poison damage each time the target fails its save, and that damage bypasses Poison Resistance.

Death Strike.summary: Hit with Sneak Attack in combat's first round: the target makes a CON save (DC 8 + DEX + PB) or takes double the attack's damage.

soulknife.summary: A Rogue whose inner psionic power forms blades of mental energy and fuels telepathy and teleportation.

Psionic Power.summary: Psionic Energy Dice: 4d6 at Rogue 3, 6d8 at 5, 8d8 at 9, 8d10 at 11, 10d10 at 13, 12d12 at 17. Regain one on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest. Fuels this subclass's powers, starting with the two below.

options.name: Psi-Bolstered Knack
options.summary: Failed a check with a proficient skill or tool? Roll a Psionic Energy Die and add it; the die is spent only if that makes it succeed.

options.name: Psychic Whispers
options.summary: Magic action: link up to PB creatures you see telepathically (1 mile reach) for hours equal to a Psionic Energy Die roll.

Psychic Blades.summary: When you Attack or make an Opportunity Attack with a free hand, form a Simple melee blade: 1d6 Psychic + the attack's modifier, Finesse, Thrown 60/120, Vex mastery (free). After it, a Bonus Action attack with a second blade deals 1d4.

Soul Blades.summary: Two new Psychic Blade powers fueled by Psionic Energy Dice.

options.name: Homing Strikes
options.summary: Missed with a Psychic Blade? Roll a Psionic Energy Die and add it to the attack; the die is spent only if it now hits.

options.name: Psychic Teleportation
options.summary: Bonus Action: spend and roll a Psionic Energy Die, then teleport to an unoccupied space you see up to 10 ft × the roll away.

Psychic Veil.summary: Magic action: become Invisible for 1 hour (dismiss anytime); it ends right after you deal damage or force a save. 1/Long Rest, or spend a Psionic Energy Die to use it again.

Rend Mind.summary: When your Psychic Blades deal Sneak Attack damage, the target makes a WIS save (DC 8 + DEX + PB) or is Stunned for 1 minute, repeating the save at each of its turn ends. 1/Long Rest, or spend 3 Psionic Energy Dice to reuse.
